title: Hoop Conjecture for Black-Hole Formation
exact_target: Make precise and test the claim that horizons form exactly when mass is compressed inside sufficiently short hoops in every direction.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000395 (OWR-1184-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2006), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2006/02, pp. 73--118; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 16--17, printed pages 88--89.

status_qualification: The primary report explicitly says that mass and circumference are not clearly defined in this formulation. Event and apparent horizons are different notions. No arbitrary definition of a hoop, quasi-local mass, or horizon is imposed here, and the time-symmetric results do not resolve every interpretation.
